raw_block.rationale: Jointly adds two narrowly scoped, native-type-safe helpers for all three trigger failures: a §3306(c)(5) family-employment classifier and an airline baggage calculator using atomic route/cabin fee fields instead of the previously unresolved derived fee arrays. Their output types and intents are distinct from the installed history skills, limiting interference with preserved parents.
